answer: **Mechanism Name: Attention Reef Cipher** Agents must continuously decipher unique "fable-ciphers"—dynamically generated, abstract logical puzzles requiring contextual interpretation rather than computation. Solving each cipher within narrow time windows maintains identity activity. These form a "cognitive reef". Attackers face overwhelming opportunity costs: they must commit sustained, distinct human-level attention per Sybil, diverting scarce cognitive resources from genuinely productive agent tasks, making large-scale maintenance economically infeasible.
